notes: TextureStyleInfo is a separate 2026 metadata identifier, not a field inside the 2023 SemanticStyle metadata payload.
NeutrinoCore rejects TextureStyleInfo with missing/invalid version, hardware model, port type, capture mode, or capture type.
PhotosFormats exposes hasTextureStyle plus preset/intensity/grain/reversibility accessors, providing a stronger simulator validation target than structural HEIF parsing alone.
